intro.h2: Floors and tile done right the first time
paragraphs: Heffner Flooring & Tile LLC handles flooring and tile in Greenbrier, Arkansas, from its base at 608 AR-25. Brandon installs luxury vinyl plank, repairs damaged planks and sets tile in kitchens, bathrooms and showers, and estimates are free and done in your home.

His reviews show what that looks like. Todd R. had a deep cut in a vinyl plank after dropping a glass, and Brandon repaired it so well that Todd can't spot it. Timothy E. says Brandon is detail oriented and makes sure the job is done right the first time. Another review mentions custom light up niches and exceptional tile work.

items.name: Luxury vinyl plank flooring
items.blurb: Luxury vinyl flooring is a topic in two of Brandon's Google reviews. Allene S. had beautiful vinyl flooring installed in her den, including the difficult cuts around the fireplace, and says it looks awesome. Ask about vinyl plank for your living areas, kitchen or bathroom.

about.text: Heffner Flooring & Tile LLC is a flooring contractor at 608 AR-25 in Greenbrier, Arkansas. Brandon is the name customers mention in their reviews. He installs luxury vinyl plank, repairs damaged floors and sets tile in kitchens, bathrooms and custom showers. Customers describe him as courteous, professional and detail oriented, and Allene S. calls him kind, humble, honest and dependable. Estimates are free and done in your home. The business keeps long hours, including evenings on weekdays, Saturdays until 8 PM and a short window on Sunday, so it is easy to find a time to talk.

process.h2: How your flooring or tile project works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (501) 589-5107, send a message on Facebook or email HeffnerFlooring@gmail.com. Todd R. says Brandon promptly returned his call.

steps.title: Free in-home estimate
steps.text: Brandon comes to your home, looks at the room or the damage and gives you an estimate at no charge.

steps.title: Install or repair
steps.text: On the agreed day, Brandon installs your new floor or tile or repairs the damaged area, with careful cuts around fireplaces and corners.

items.name: Todd R.
items.text:
I'm in a newly built home with luxury vinyl flooring.  I stumbled over a puppy and dropped a glass on the floor which cut into the vinyl plank.  It was very noticeable.   I left Brandon a voicemail.  He promptly returned my call and came out the next day to give me an estimate.
2 days later he showed up as promised and performed the repair.  I'm VERY PLEASED!!  He repaired the damaged area to the point where I can't t spot it.  Better than I ever expected.
He's very courteous and professional.

items.name: Timothy E.
items.text: Brandon did an excellent job installing tile in our bathroom and kitchen! He was very professional and detail oriented. He makes sure it’s done right the first time! I would highly recommend him to anyone needing any tile work!

items.name: Allene S.
items.text: This flooring company did an amazing job for us! He was very professional, he installed some beautiful vinyl flooring and it looks awesome 👌 we are very happy with his work!! He definitely knows his stuff 👍 we have a fireplace in our den and it looked pretty difficult to have to cut around it to make it look good and he did it 😉  what I really admire about this young man is he is a minister of the gospel and is very kind and humble! He has a beautiful wife and 3 darling children. If you need someone honest and dependable plz give him a try! You'll be glad you did 😃

service_area.h2: Flooring and tile in Greenbrier and the local area
service_area.text: Heffner Flooring & Tile LLC is based at 608 AR-25 in Greenbrier, Arkansas, and says it serves the local community. The Google listing does not name other towns, so if you live outside Greenbrier, call (501) 589-5107 or send a message on Facebook with your town and a short description of the floor or tile job to check that Brandon can come out.

items.q: Can you repair a damaged vinyl plank floor?
items.a: Yes. Todd R. dropped a glass that cut into a vinyl plank in his newly built home. Brandon came out the next day for an estimate and did the repair two days later. Todd says he can't spot the damaged area and calls it better than he ever expected.

Yes. Heffner Flooring & Tile offers free in-home estimates. Brandon comes to your home, looks at the room or the damage and talks through the options. Call (501) 589-5107 or send a message on Facebook to set up a time that works for you.

items.q: Do you install tile in kitchens and bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Timothy E. had tile installed in his bathroom and kitchen and says Brandon did an excellent job. The photos also show a custom walk-in shower with travertine-look walls, a hexagon mosaic floor, two benches and two lit niches. Ask about floors, walls, showers and backsplashes.

items.q: Can you handle tricky cuts, like around a fireplace?
items.a: Allene S. had vinyl flooring installed in her den, where the fireplace looked difficult to cut around. She says he did it, the floor looks awesome and he definitely knows his stuff. If your room has odd corners or a hearth, mention it when you call.

Heffner Flooring & Tile is open Monday to Friday from 7:30 AM to 7 PM, Saturday from 8 AM to 8 PM and Sunday from 11:30 AM to 2 PM. The address is 608 AR-25, Greenbrier, AR 72058. Call before you stop by so Brandon is there.

final_cta.text: Call Brandon at Heffner Flooring & Tile to talk about your floor, repair or tile project.
